data.title: A nucleus on a magnet board
data.goal: A nucleus on a magnet board

memoryNodes.cue: Protons and neutrons form the nucleus.
memoryNodes.cueZh: 质子和中子组成原子核。

memoryNodes.cue: Electron labels stay outside the centre.
Jo finds carbon by its number.

data.situation:
The guide chose a carbon atom for the next model. Magnets marked proton and neutron sat in the nucleus, while electron labels belonged outside it. The arrangement was a simple teaching model, not a photograph or a map of exact particle positions. An electronic counter beside the board responded when a visitor pressed a button. At the far end, the periodic table arranged the elements by atomic number. Jo counted the proton labels in the carbon model and found the corresponding number on the table. Maya photographed the board rather than moving any of its pieces. Jo: Is an electron part of the nucleus?
Guide: In this atom, electrons are outside the nucleus.
Maya: Why carbon?
Guide: It gives us a familiar example for comparing the model and the periodic table.

readingBlocks.en: The guide chose a carbon atom for the next model. Magnets marked proton and neutron sat in the nucleus, while electron labels belonged outside it. The arrangement was a simple teaching model, not a photograph or a map of exact particle positions. An electronic counter beside the board responded when a visitor pressed a button. At the far end, the periodic table arranged the elements by atomic number. Jo counted the proton labels in the carbon model and found the corresponding number on the table. Maya photographed the board rather than moving any of its pieces.
readingBlocks.zh: 讲解员为下一模型选择碳原子。标为质子和中子的磁块放在原子核中，电子标签在外面。这是简化教学模型，不是照片，也不是粒子精确位置图。板边电子计数器在游客按键时响应。远端元素周期表按原子序数排列元素。乔数碳模型的质子标签，再到表上找对应数字。玛雅拍下板子，没有移动模型部件。

readingBlocks.en:
Jo: Is an electron part of the nucleus?
Guide: In this atom, electrons are outside the nucleus.
Maya: Why carbon?
Guide: It gives us a familiar example for comparing the model and the periodic table.
readingBlocks.zh:
乔：电子是原子核的一部分吗？
讲解员：在这个原子里，电子在原子核外。
玛雅：为什么选碳？
讲解员：这个熟悉的例子方便比较模型和元素周期表。

glossary.note: 带正电的质子；a proton，复数 protons。
glossary.example: A proton label sat in the model nucleus.
glossary.exampleZh: 质子标签放在模型的原子核中。

externalEvidence.definition: a stable particle with positive charge equal to the negative charge of an electron

glossary.note: 中子不带净电荷；某些原子核没有中子。
glossary.example: Neutron labels were beside the proton labels.
glossary.exampleZh: 中子标签在质子标签旁。

externalEvidence.label: Oxford Learner’s Dictionaries
externalEvidence.reviewFinding: Neutral nuclear particle; WordNet elementary-particle wording is not adopted.

glossary.note: 这里指原子核；复数 nuclei。
glossary.example: The carbon model had a nucleus at its centre.

externalEvidence.definition: the positively charged dense center of an atom

glossary.note: 带负电的电子；模型中的位置并非实际轨道。
glossary.example: Electron labels were outside the nucleus.

externalEvidence.definition: an elementary particle with negative charge

glossary.note: 这里指物理粒子，如 a subatomic particle。
glossary.example: The model did not show exact particle positions.
glossary.exampleZh: 模型没有展示粒子的精确位置。

externalEvidence.label: Oxford Learner’s Dictionaries
externalEvidence.reviewFinding: Small matter/subatomic particle sense; do not force internal-structure WordNet definition onto every electron.

glossary.zh: 使用电子电路或电子器件的
glossary.note: 电子设备可说 electronic equipment；electron 是电子这个粒子。
glossary.example: The electronic counter responded to a button.

externalEvidence.definition: of or relating to electronics; concerned with or using devices that operate on principles governing the behavior of electrons

glossary.zh: 按原子序数及元素性质组织的元素周期表
glossary.example: Jo found carbon on the periodic table.
glossary.exampleZh: 乔在元素周期表上找到碳。

externalEvidence.definition: (chemistry) a tabular arrangement of the chemical elements according to atomic number as based on the periodic law
